name: approval-pack
title: DRAFT: marketing approval pack
for_each: select id,code from briefs order by code

sections.title: Current creative wording
sections.sql: select v.version,v.copy,v.channel,v.evidence_ref from versions v join briefs b on b.id=v.brief_id and b.current_version=v.version where b.id=$1

sections.title: Claim support
sections.sql: select c.code,c.statement,c.reference,c.explanation,c.checked_on,c.valid_until from (select cl.code,cl.statement,s.reference,s.explanation,s.checked_on,s.valid_until,v.brief_id from claims cl join versions v on v.id=cl.version_id join briefs b on b.id=v.brief_id and b.current_version=v.version left join substantiations s on s.claim_id=cl.id)c where c.brief_id=$1

sections.title: Reviewer record
sections.note: Declared reviewer names and references require external verification. No authenticated signatures.
sections.sql: select r.role,r.reviewer,r.due_on,r.decision,r.reference from v_reviews r join briefs b on b.code=r.brief where b.id=$1

name: release-checklist
title: DRAFT: launch review worksheet
for_each: select id,code from briefs order by code

sections.title: Open record checks
sections.note: A clean worksheet does not establish legal compliance or permission to publish. Review the complete creative and supporting evidence.
sections.sql: select c.rule,c.finding,c.item from v_compliance c join briefs b on b.code=c.brief where b.id=$1

sections.title: Recorded external releases
sections.sql: select v.version,r.location,r.released_on,r.reference from release_records r join versions v on v.id=r.version_id where v.brief_id=$1
